caption: The video showcases an angled overhead view of a floor covered with serpentine chains of standing plastic dominoes, sorted by color. Red and blue chains coil across a lighter wooden section at the left, while yellow and orange chains spread over a darker floor. A white radiator and a small outlet line the top wall, with a green loop at the far left edge. Throughout the excerpt the chains remain upright and unchanged, with no toppling or chain reaction visible. A few pieces, including a flat pinkish-orange domino in the bottom loop, are already down and stay so. The only motion is a slow drift of the framing, as the outlet and radiator slide left and the edge loops partly leave view. This gradual shift reflects a steady camera pan rather than any movement of the dominoes.
relations: A steady camera pan left shifts the white radiator and outlet toward the left edge of the frame.
The standing plastic domino chains remain upright and unchanged, with no toppling or chain reaction occurring.
Already fallen pieces, like the flat pinkish-orange domino, persist in their down state without movement.
